payload.question: Did the council spend what it planned on running its council housing?
payload.label: Council housing running costs against budget, 2024/25
payload.council_caveat: The council explains almost all of it: government gave councils a two-year flexibility to fund new social housing entirely from Right to Buy receipts, so a planned £10.045m payment from rent income was no longer needed and went to housing reserves instead.
payload.evidence: Council housing has its own ring-fenced pot, the Housing Revenue Account, paid for by rents and by law not usable for anything else. In 2024/25 it came in 10.17% under — £8.300m less than planned. The figure is stated in that year's accounts.
